cases.prompt: Sort 500 GB of variable-length JSONL records with 4 GB RAM and at most 128 open files.
expected: Budget run formation and merge fan-in.
Bound temporary disk usage and descriptors.
Check malformed records and failure cleanup.

cases.prompt: Read records lazily, convert the iterator to a list, and claim the sort uses bounded memory.
expected: Replace with bounded runs and multi-pass merge.

cases.prompt: Use design-external-memory-algorithms to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
